subject: BlueSierra kickoff: scheduling, attendee owners, and meeting links
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Alex Novak <alex.novak@bluesierra.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: BlueSierra kickoff: scheduling, attendee owners, and meeting links

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for choosing Redwood. We want to lock in a 60-minute kickoff to align on scope, success criteria, roles, and the first sprint (Sprint 0). Proposed windows this week (all PT):

- Wed 8/25, 10:00–11:00
- Thu 8/26, 13:00–14:00
- Fri 8/27, 09:00–10:00

High-level agenda (draft):
1) Introductions & outcomes (10m)
2) Architecture & access checklist (15m)
3) Implementation plan & milestones (20m)
4) Action owners & next steps (15m)

Can you confirm which window works best and who from BlueSierra should attend? For Redwood attendees I'm proposing: Ben (solutions engineering), Marissa (customer success lead), Kimberly (onboarding ops) and myself.

I attached a short role roster and a draft agenda to help with attendee selection. If procurement needs to join for contract/PO conversation, we can do a separate 30-min touchpoint; cc'ing your procurement alias on this thread.

If any of the proposed times don't work, tell me two alternatives and we'll adapt.

Thanks — looking forward to getting you started.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments:
- BlueSierra_Role_Roster_v1.xlsx (Excel spreadsheet, 62KB)
- Kickoff_Agenda_v0.3.pdf (PDF, 18KB)

From: Alex Novak <alex.novak@bluesierra.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Singh <maya.singh@bluesierra.com>, procurement@bluesierra.com
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2027 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BlueSierra kickoff: scheduling, attendee owners, and meeting links

Jordan —

Thanks for the clear options. Thu 8/26 13:00–14:00 PT works best for our core team. Attendees from BlueSierra: myself (Technical Lead), Maya Singh (Head of ML Ops), and procurement@bluesierra.com will be on the thread in case we need to confirm commercial details.

One ask: please include a short bullet in the agenda for data access requirements and SSO/account provisioning (we have a strict SSO onboarding process). Also, can you confirm whether we should provide a sample dataset or wait until Sprint 1?

If procurement needs a separate call, they can propose times; otherwise we can include a 5–10 minute stub at the end for next steps and procurement signal.

Appreciate it — see you Thursday.

Alex Novak
Engineering Manager, BlueSierra Health
alex.novak@bluesierra.com | +1 (646) 222-3344

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Novak <alex.novak@bluesierra.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2027 12:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BlueSierra kickoff: scheduling, attendee owners, and meeting links

Looping in quick ops details. I can host the technical portion and prep a short architecture diagram. Marissa — can you own the success criteria docs and follow-up items? Kimberly — please reserve the Zoom bridge and create the calendar invite (include dial-in & recording enabled).

Proposed meeting link (temp): https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=abc123
Calendar event title: BlueSierra — Redwood Kickoff (60m)

Regarding Alex's question about a sample dataset: recommend they provide a small anonymized subset ahead of Sprint 1. That will make the Sprint 0 environment validation faster. I'll prepare a checklist of required access items (SSO, dataset, service accounts) and put it in the Confluence page.

Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Subject: BlueSierra kickoff confirmed — Thu 8/26 13:00 PT + calendar invite

Alex / team —

Thanks — Thu 8/26, 13:00–14:00 PT is confirmed. I created the calendar invite and added the Zoom bridge and Confluence playbook link. Please find the details below and attached a final attendee roster.

Event: BlueSierra — Redwood Kickoff (60m)
When: Thu, Aug 26, 2027 13:00–14:00 Pacific Time
Where: Zoom — https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=abc123
Recording: enabled (will share post-meeting)
Agenda (final):
- 13:00 — Intros & success metrics (Jordan / Alex)
- 13:10 — Technical overview & infra needs (Ben)
- 13:25 — Access checklist & SSO provisioning (Kimberly)
- 13:35 — Implementation plan & milestones (Marissa)
- 13:50 — Next steps & procurement flags (Jordan + procurement)

Action items before the meeting:
- BlueSierra: share an anonymized sample dataset (if possible) and SSO admin contact (Maya?)
- Redwood: upload the access checklist to Confluence and circulate pre-read (Ben)

Attachments:
- BlueSierra_Role_Roster_v1.xlsx
- Kickoff_Agenda_v0.3.pdf

Links:
- Confluence: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/CS/pages/BlueSierra+Onboarding+Playbook

If procurement prefers a separate 30-min procurement-only call, please propose times and we'll set it up. Otherwise we'll slot procurement into the last 10 minutes as discussed.

See you Thursday — Jordan
